_comment: Machine-readable domain vocabulary consumed by the analyzer tools (brain_atlas_anchor, dti_aggregator, effect_size_aggregator, cohort_tracker). THIS IS THE NEUTRAL BASELINE: every section is empty, so those tools no-op with a helpful message instead of assuming a domain. To configure a real domain, copy a *.example.json file in this folder over this one (e.g. cp domain.stroke.example.json domain.json) or fill the sections below. Mirror your prose context.md here. See docs/tools.md > 'Domain configuration'.

_conventions.regions_tracts: Each entry: {canonical: display name, aliases: [plain strings]}. Tools escape aliases and match on word boundaries.
_conventions.metric_and_scale_aliases: dti_metrics / outcome_scales / cohort.* values are lists of REGEX FRAGMENTS, OR-joined raw (NOT escaped). This lets you encode numeric patterns like '>\s*6\s*month'.
